request.description: Exactly one operation. Include only parameters declared for its action.

oneOf.description: Read readiness, system permissions, authorized apps and current control owner. No other parameters.
Discover applications, exact bundleId and running state.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring of application name or bundleId. Omit to list all discoverable desktop apps.

oneOf.description: Launch a discovered application after application authorization; then list its windows.

app.description: Exact opaque bundleId returned by list_apps (macOS Bundle ID or Windows executable/launch identity); a unique exact application name is also accepted.

oneOf.description: List windows of a running application. Select the exact window_id for observation.

app.description: Exact opaque bundleId returned by list_apps (macOS Bundle ID or Windows executable/launch identity); a unique exact application name is also accepted.

oneOf.description: Observe the exact window: fresh snapshot, accessibility elements, completeness metadata and optional screenshot (long edge at most 1440 pixels).

app.description: Exact opaque bundleId returned by list_apps (macOS Bundle ID or Windows executable/launch identity); a unique exact application name is also accepted.

window_id.description: Exact window_id from list_windows, kept as a decimal string.

query.description: Case-insensitive accessibility tree filter: matching rows plus ancestors, with unchanged identifiers. Does not guarantee an exhaustive tree walk.

include_screenshot.description: Default true: screenshot plus accessibility elements. False returns accessibility only; pixel actions require another observation with a valid screenshot.

max_elements.description: accessibility element budget: default 600, maximum 1500. Inspect truncated and elements_complete before concluding a control is absent.

max_depth.description: accessibility depth limit: default 25, maximum 40. Increase for deeply nested controls. The Host also limits the walk to 5 seconds.

oneOf.description: Activate an accessibility element or click screenshot pixels. Requires element_token OR the pair x,y.

app.description: Exact opaque bundleId returned by list_apps (macOS Bundle ID or Windows executable/launch identity); a unique exact application name is also accepted.

window_id.description: Exact window_id from list_windows, kept as a decimal string.

snapshot_id.description: snapshot_id from the latest get_window_state for this window. Valid for one action and at most 60 seconds; observe again after each action or refusal.

element_token.description: Exact element_token from the latest observation. Prefer an enabled element with appropriate role/actions. Use this token OR x AND y, never both addressing modes.

x.description: X in returned window screenshot pixels from the top-left corner. Supply y too; omit element_token. Do not use desktop coordinates or unconverted accessibility frame coordinates.

y.description: Y in the same window screenshot pixels as x. Supply x too; omit element_token.

foreground.description: Default false: best-effort background delivery. Set true only after fresh observation confirms background failure; Moss requests foreground authorization for this run.

button.description: Default left. With an accessibility token, right requests the context menu; middle may require the pixel route.

count.description: Pixel clicks only: 1 (default) or 2 for double-click. Omit for accessibility actions.

ax_action.description: accessibility token only. Match an observed action (AXPress → press, AXShowMenu → show_menu); macOS default press; Windows default invoke, expand opens a dropdown. Use only platform-supported actions.

modifier.description: Click modifiers, e.g. ["shift"]. Modified clicks may need foreground delivery; observe after refusal before requesting it.
